# Jeeni

> Jeeni is an AI-ROI consulting firm that turns futurist research into measurable value. We track revenue and savings from day one for clear ROI. Our core message: stop asking what AI can do—start asking what it costs, and what it earns.

## What Jeeni does
- Measures the true cost of AI adoption and the return it generates, from day one.
- Delivers ROI three ways: Revenue Growth, Time Reclaimed (20+ hours/week on average), and Cost Optimization.
- Starts every engagement with an AI audit and readiness assessment, then a prioritized roadmap.
- Research-backed by insights from global business leaders at Davos 2026.

## Services
- AI Readiness & Strategy Roadmap — assess readiness, audit operations, prioritize high-value opportunities.
- Custom Solutions & Implementation — strategy aligned to business goals; build custom AI solutions.
- Workflow Automation & Efficiency — remove bottlenecks (repetitive email, manual data entry, slow reporting).
- Data & Analytics Automation — AI-powered systems that audit readiness and analyze patterns.
- Content & Marketing Automation — scale marketing with measurable lift.
- Venture Strategy & Advisory — build lean and fast with an AI-readiness focus.
